protocol.name: surface-bound real-image patch refinement
protocol.reference_patch: 8x8 grayscale pixels bound to frozen local fitted surface planes
protocol.online_observation: reference and query image bilinear samples at candidate-pose projections

visual_objectives.joint: mean normalized pixel residual squared with shared outer soft_l1
visual_objectives.patch_robust: mean Huber(||patch_residual||_2/sqrt(m)) with fixed training scale and sqrt(m) small-error scale alignment

protocol.patch_robust_scale_alignment: sqrt(per-patch pixel count), fixed by patch_size
protocol.visibility_filter: frozen map-point z-buffer at LEADER initial pose for visibility variant
